当前，人工智能已成为国际竞争的新焦点和经济发展的新引擎，“人工智能+”正加速重塑: At present, artificial intelligence has become a new focal point of international competition and a new engine of economic development, and "AI+" is accelerating the reshaping of new competitive advantages for the nation
记者梳理31份省级“十五五”规划纲要发现，“人工智能”一词累计出现超1400次，: A review by reporters of 31 provincial "15th Five-Year Plan" outlines reveals that the term "artificial intelligence" appears cumulatively over 1,400 times, with regions grounding themselves in their own resource endowments, insisting on dual advancement of technological innovation and application empowerment, forging differentiated development paths of simultaneous "strengthening foundations" and "expanding applications," and injecting data and intelligent momentum into cultivating and developing new productive forces and building a modern industrial system
在筑牢数智化发展底座上，各地将围绕“算力、算法、数据”三大核心能力建设开展系统布: In solidifying the foundation for digital and intelligent development, regions will conduct systematic deployment around the construction of "three core capabilities" of computing power, algorithms, and data: 23 provinces have proposed strengthening computing power infrastructure construction or optimizing layouts, 17 provinces focus on large model and algorithm innovation, and 27 provinces deploy high-quality dataset construction
算力是人工智能的底座: Computing power is the foundation of artificial intelligence
在算力建设方面，安徽、吉林等10个省份提出将深入实施或主动融入国家“东数西算”战: In computing power construction, 10 provinces including Anhui and Jilin have proposed deeply implementing or actively integrating into the national "Eastern Data to Western Computing" strategic layout
安徽提出提升“东数西算”全国一体化算力网络长三角枢纽节点芜湖数据中心集群集聚能力: Anhui has proposed enhancing the computing capacity of the Wuhu data center cluster of the Yangtze River Delta hub node of the national unified "Eastern Data to Western Computing" computing power network and actively exploring the "computing power enclave" development model
有17个省份还将绿色低碳作为算力设施建设的基本原则，宁夏、重庆等地直接提出新建算: 17 provinces have also made green and low-carbon principles the foundation for computing power facility construction, with regions such as Ningxia and Chongqing directly proposing a hard target that green electricity accounts for no less than 80% in newly built computing power facilities
算法模型是人工智能的“灵魂”: Algorithm models are the "soul" of artificial intelligence
各地在研发算法模型上，以“通用大模型+行业垂直大模型”双轮驱动为主流路线: In developing algorithm models, regions are following the mainstream approach of "general-purpose large models plus industry-specific vertical large models" as dual drivers
安徽、广东、江苏等9个省份明确在支持通用大模型研发的同时，聚焦本地优势产业打造垂: 9 provinces including Anhui, Guangdong, and Jiangsu have explicitly focused on supporting general-purpose large model research while concentrating on building vertical large models for local advantageous industries
没有高质量数据，就难以训练出高质量的人工智能大模型: Without high-quality data, it is difficult to train high-quality AI large models
例如，福建将围绕政务、医疗、海洋、低空等重点领域打造一批跨区域跨部门的人工智能高: For example, Fujian will create a batch of cross-region and cross-department high-quality AI datasets around key areas such as government services, healthcare, marine resources, and low-altitude economy
全面实施“人工智能+”行动，是推进现代化产业体系建设、加快发展新质生产力的关键举: Comprehensively implementing the "AI+" action is a key initiative for advancing the construction of a modern industrial system and accelerating the development of new productive forces
围绕深入实施“人工智能+”行动，有18个省份的“十五五”规划纲要作出进一步部署，: Surrounding the in-depth implementation of the "AI+" action, 18 provinces have made further deployments in their "15th Five-Year Plan" outlines, with six major priority sectors as the core including scientific technology, industrial development, consumption upgrading, public welfare, governance capacity, and global cooperation, and grounding themselves in local resources, striving to cultivate "AI+" local characteristic industries
例如，在“人工智能+”产业发展领域，新能源汽车产业优势明显的安徽将构建智能网联新: For example, in the field of "AI+" industrial development, Anhui, with obvious advantages in the new energy vehicle industry, will construct a highly reliable world-class large model in the intelligent connected new energy vehicle field and establish a public service platform for intelligent robots integrating functions of parts production, scenario training, and product testing
在“人工智能+”消费提质领域，文旅资源丰富的河南将鼓励旅游景区、度假区、休闲街区: In the field of "AI+" consumption upgrading, Henan, rich in cultural and tourism resources, will encourage scenic areas, resorts, leisure districts, industrial heritage sites, and museums to create "AI+ smart tourism" immersive experience spaces
国家发展改革委高技术司副司长张铠麟表示，发展“人工智能+”要坚持因地制宜，将推动: Zhang Kailin, deputy director of the High-tech Division of the National Development and Reform Commission, stated that developing "AI+" must adhere to the principle of adapting to local conditions, promoting each region to ground itself in regional characteristics, resource endowments, and industrial foundations, scientifically determine development priorities, form a development situation with distinct characteristics, respective effectiveness, and complementary advantages, and firmly avoid disorderly competition and rushed action
